## Data Centers & Public Health

### Research Question

> What public health impacts, risks, and mitigation approaches have been described in the literature related to data center development and management? 

### Research Focus

This project examines evidence across multiple disciplines, including: 

- Public Health
- Environmental health
- Engineering 
- Sustainability 
- Environmental science 
- Policy
- Community health

The goal is to better understand how communities can evaluate the potential benefits and burdens of data center development.
